verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a capability a remote-desktop and collaboration product could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any task delegation inside Parsec. The Teams API automates deployment and reporting, which is a developer building block rather than an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
